:::{#hero-heading}

A practitioner‑scholar climbs an endless, DNA-shaped staircase woven from streams of binary code. Each step is a piece of lived experience: experiments, applications, and theories.

## Meaning

- Spiral stairway: Continuous personal growth; knowledge is never linear.
- Binary‑rooted tree of light: The fusion of data and insight blooming into sustainable innovation.
- Circuit‑blueprint backdrop of home appliances: Grounding philosophy in real‑world engineering.
- Interlocking gear & leaf icons: The symbiosis of efficiency and environmental care—technology in service of life.

Together they frame a meditation on praxis: how deep learning—both human and algorithmic—emerges when theory meets the constraints of the physical world, and how every hard‑won lesson becomes the next foothold upward.

:::
